subject: Operational checklist for UK Addendum rollforward and TIA evidence
messages:
From: Karen Smythe <karen.smythe@northlighthealth.co.uk>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@northlighthealth.co.uk>
Date: 10 May 2026 09:12 BST
Subject: TIA evidence & UK Addendum timing for NorthLight procurement

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — procurement has kicked off and Legal needs a compact package so we can sign off on the security gates. Specifically we need: 

- Completed TIA/DTIA questionnaire (the attached NorthLight template) with explicit notes on international data paths (EU -> US) and any subprocessors involved.
- Current subprocessor map with country of processing, data types processed, and whether SCCs or another lawful basis are in place.
- Draft of Redwood's UK Addendum or confirmation of timeline for rollout (our counsel prefers to review a draft).
- Evidence of SCCs in place with major infra subprocessors (CloudOps, CDN provider), and any TIA/transfer impact notes.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can produce the above by EOD Friday (2026-05-14)? Also please flag any items that would require an exception or longer lead time (for example: extended retention for audit logs, or non-EU subprocessors requiring contractual addenda).

Attachments: northlight_tia_questionnaire_20260510.pdf (NorthLight template)

Regards,
Karen Smythe
Senior Counsel, Information Security
NorthLight Health
[karen.smythe@northlighthealth.co.uk]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karen Smythe <karen.smythe@northlighthealth.co.uk>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 10 May 2026 10:04 BST
Subject: Re: TIA evidence & UK Addendum timing for NorthLight procurement

Karen — thanks for the clear list. We can meet most of these items on the timeline but want to be transparent about two points up front: (1) one infra subprocessor (CloudOps) performs some control-plane logging in the US which requires SCCs + TIA annotations, and (2) UK Addendum rollout is scheduled as a coordinated release (legal + engineering) rather than an immediate unilateral patch.

I'll coordinate the evidence package. Action items we are taking now:
- Laura: lead on the TIA questionnaire and compile subprocessor map (deliverable: CSV + short narrative).
- Vivek: confirm which subprocessors have executed SCCs and prepare any TIA notes on residual risk & mitigation (e.g., encryption in transit/at rest, geo-routing).
- Irene: review proposed UK Addendum draft and surface any high-risk contractual points that would need redlines or an SLA carve-out.

We will attach existing SCC execution confirmations where available and a draft UK Addendum for your counsel to review. If NorthLight requires a change to our default retention for audit logs (longer than 90 days), that will need an exec approval — I will flag for leadership if needed.

Target: we will aim to send a first bundle by Thursday morning UTC (2026-05-13 09:00 UTC) so you have time before your Friday deadline. If anything is mission-critical sooner please call me directly.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment notes: we will include the redwood_subprocessor_map_20260510.csv and a draft of the proposed_uk_addendum_draft_20260511.docx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 11 May 2026 07:42 BST
Subject: Fwd: TIA questionnaire - compiling evidence

Marissa — forwarding my updates. I have started the subprocessor CSV and attached the working version. Short notes: CloudOps (us-east-1) processes control-plane logs (minimal PII) -> SCC executed (signed copy available but needs redaction of signatures for vendor). CDN-Edge (eu-west-1) is EU-only. Identity provider is EU-hosted.

Questions for you / Karen:
- For the NorthLight questionnaire, do they expect us to include token-level retention TTLs (we can provide default TTLs and an audit log retention exception if they need >90 days)?
- Do we include a redacted SCC as evidence or the full executed contract? I recommend redacted for vendor privacy; NorthLight legal can request full on an NDA.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_map_20260510.csv (working)

Laura Bennett
Privacy & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karen Smythe <karen.smythe@northlighthealth.co.uk>, Tom Hale <tom.hale@northlighthealth.co.uk>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 12 May 2026 16:28 PDT
Subject: Re: TIA evidence & UK Addendum timing for NorthLight procurement

Karen / Tom — attaching the first evidence bundle as discussed. High-level summary below and attachments included as redacted stubs for initial review. If this looks acceptable we will provide executed SCCs under your standard mutual NDA process and a finalized UK Addendum via DocuSign.

Summary (documents attached):
- TIA questionnaire: completed with data flow diagrams (EU primary, optional US control-plane logs), mitigation notes (encryption in transit & at rest, prefix/KV cache controls). [Attachment: completed_tia_response_20260512.pdf]
- Subprocessor map: CSV with country, data types, SCC status (redwood_subprocessor_map_20260510.csv). Notable: CloudOps (US) — SCCs executed; control-plane logs documented.
- SCC evidence: redacted SCC confirmation stubs (to avoid sharing vendor PII). Full executed copies available on request under NDA. [Attachment: scc_redacted_stub_CloudOps.pdf]
- Draft UK Addendum: proposed_uk_addendum_draft_20260511.docx (legal review requested).

Timeline & next steps:
- We expect to have any requested full SCCs and the DocuSign-ready UK Addendum within 7 business days (target 2026-05-21) provided NorthLight doesn't require expanded retention >90 days for audit logs. If you need >90 day retention, please confirm and we'll escalate for exec sign-off (this may add ~5 business days).
- Please confirm whether redacted SCCs are acceptable for initial procurement review.

Links / references: HubSpot deal NLH-2026-007 (https://hubspot.redwood/deals/NLH-2026-007), draft on Drive (https://drive.redwood.com/s/UK-Addendum-DRAFT).

Attachments (stubs): completed_tia_response_20260512.pdf, redwood_subprocessor_map_20260510.csv, scc_redacted_stub_CloudOps.pdf, proposed_uk_addendum_draft_20260511.docx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142
[If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute call with our privacy and infra teams to walk through the TIA and subprocessor map — say when works for you.]
